data.gender_notes: Masudah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Masudah is derived from the Arabic root ‘sauda’, which means ‘hope’ or ‘aspiration’. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that Masudah represents the faith and trust placed in Allah, especially during times of hardship and uncertainty. The name Masudah carries the meaning “Hope, Aspiration” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Masudah usually hope their child will grow to embody hope, aspiration and live with faith, good character and purpose.
